unicode.scope: Independent read-only key ABI/Unicode/RCW/pin/exclusive-copy audit, plus one actual targeted metadata-only compile/COM stage/reopen. No real shortcut deployment, UI, owner or model.

findings.detail: ShellLink CLSID and Unicode F9 IID; 18 IShellLinkW methods after IUnknown match native header order and widths. LPWSTR input explicitly marshalled; output char arrays are U2 with count parameter at index 1. WORD ushort, DWORD uint, int32 and borrowed pointer positions match.

GetPath uses raw-path flag 4 and NULL findData, documented valid. Only S_OK accepted, S_FALSE/no valid path refuses. NUL termination checked; metadata target/args/workdir/icon/AppID compared to pinned plan.
Framework definition supplies LPWStr Load/Save/SaveCompleted and BOOL Save flag; Save true then SaveCompleted for the same file. No handmade replacement interface.

One RCW object per Create/Read released once in finally; interface aliases not separately FinalReleased. Existing IPropertyStore Get/Set/Commit and VT_LPWSTR CoTaskMem allocation/PropVariantClear nested finally unchanged.

Main byte-identical to committed baseline: fixed actions, real-known-folder staging refusal, all config/manifest/entry/launcher/icon pins, fixed targets, exclusive CopyFileW true, fresh readback retained.
